item.description:
I am a Maître de Conférences (associate professor) at Université de Caen Normandie, in the IMAGE team of the GREYC laboratory.

Before that, I was a postdoctoral fellow at IMT Nord Europe, working with Vincent Itier on the detection of AI-generated images, with a focus on making detectors generalize across different generative models. Prior to that, I was a postdoctoral fellow at CRIStAL, working with Pierre Chainais, Pierre-Antoine Thouvenin and Jérémie Boulanger on geometric and polarization priors for solving inverse problems involving bivariate signals. I did my PhD in the GAIA team at GIPSA-lab, under the supervision of Nicolas Tremblay, Simon Barthelmé and Pierre-Olivier Amblard. My thesis focused on Monte Carlo algorithms for linear algebra based on random spanning forests, a stochastic process on graphs. See my thesis for more details.
